description: Verify the configured Marketo credentials by minting an OAuth bearer token against the identity endpoint. Returns ok, base_url, client_id.
embedding_description: Verify ONLY that Marketo credentials are reachable — mint a bearer token against the configured instance, confirming the marketo_instance address-book entry is complete and the client_id/client_secret are valid. Does NOT check what the API user's Role can actually DO; for that, run check_setup instead. Diagnostic only, no marketing data touched.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Verify the configured Marketo instance is reachable.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.not_configured: no marketo_instance address-book entry registered yet. marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth client_id/client_secret were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.not_configured: register the marketo_instance address-book entry (see hydration_guidance.md). marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the LaunchPoint custom service's client_id/client_secret.
